title: kube-tower
description: Outdated container images and Helm charts across Kubernetes clusters (kube-tower exporter)

panels.title: Outdated images
panels.description: Distinct images (registry/repository:tag) with a newer version, in the selected clusters

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

count((kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (image, tag) kube_tower_image_outdated{update="major"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Outdated Helm charts
panels.description: ArgoCD Applications whose chart or one of its subcharts has a newer version

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_chart_outdated{cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1) or vector(0)
count(kube_tower_cluster_reachable{cluster=~"$cluster"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Last scan
panels.description: Time since the end of the last scan

targets.expr: time() - max(kube_tower_last_scan_timestamp_seconds)

panels.title: Scan errors
panels.description: Non fatal collection errors of the last scan (e.g. a resource kube-tower is not allowed to list): see the Status page

targets.expr: max(kube_tower_last_scan_errors)
count by (status) (kube_tower_image_outdated and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))
count by (update) (kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))
count by (status) (kube_tower_chart_outdated{cluster=~"$cluster"})

count by (cluster) (group by (cluster, image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}) and on (image, tag) kube_tower_image_outdated == 1)

panels.title: Outdated images
panels.description: One line per image: an image used in several clusters is listed once

targets.expr: kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})
kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} * on (image, tag) group_left (latest, update) (kube_tower_image_outdated == 1)

panels.title: Helm charts (ArgoCD Applications)
panels.description: status is the worst status of the chart and its subcharts

targets.expr: kube_tower_chart_outdated{cluster=~"$cluster"}
kube_tower_chart_dependency_outdated{cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1

panels.title: Images with critical CVEs
panels.description: Distinct images with at least one critical vulnerability, in the selected clusters

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="critical"} > 0 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Images with high CVEs
panels.description: Distinct images with at least one high vulnerability, in the selected clusters

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="high"} > 0 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fixable critical/high CVEs
panels.description: Critical and high vulnerabilities fixed in a newer version of the package (all images of the selected clusters)

targets.expr: sum(kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities_fixable{severity=~"critical|high"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: End of life OS
panels.description: Images whose OS release no longer gets security fixes

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_os_eosl == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed vulnerability scans
panels.description: Images whose vulnerability scan failed (see the kube-tower logs or the Vulnerabilities page)

targets.expr: count(kube_tower_image_vulnerability_scan_failed == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Last vulnerability scan
panels.description: Time since the end of the last vulnerability scan

targets.expr: time() - max(kube_tower_last_vulnerability_scan_timestamp_seconds)

panels.title: Vulnerabilities by severity
panels.description: Vulnerabilities of all the images of the selected clusters (an image counts once, whatever the number of clusters)

targets.expr: sum by (severity) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))
sum by (severity) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: Most vulnerable images
panels.description: Vulnerabilities per image and severity, the most critical first; fixable: fixed in a newer version of the package

targets.expr: sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="critical"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="high"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="medium"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="low"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="unknown"} and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

sum by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities_fixable and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: Workloads running an image with critical vulnerabilities

targets.expr: kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} * on (image, tag) group_left (source) (kube_tower_image_vulnerabilities{severity="critical"} > 0)
kube_tower_cluster_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on (cluster) group_left kube_tower_cluster_reachable
count(kube_tower_image_outdated == 1 and on (image, tag) group by (image, tag) (kube_tower_image_workload_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} or kube_tower_image_nodes{cluster=~"$cluster"}))
count(kube_tower_chart_outdated{cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1)
count(kube_tower_chart_dependency_outdated{cluster=~"$cluster"} == 1)
max(kube_tower_last_scan_duration_seconds)
